purpose: Static contract inventory for #292; not a replacement OpenAPI specification or proof of runtime deployment/security. See developer-corpus-audit.md for limits and decision handoff.
identityPolicy: Version + HTTP method + source path; no operationId is declared in either OpenAPI catalog. Parameter-normalized matching is comparison evidence only, not a chosen stable SDK name.

account.authority: Authenticated account; exact top-level collection read/write scope when permissions are stored; account grants do not bypass domain checks.

event-read.authority: Event membership plus resource-specific projection; member lists/response lists can additionally require viewAttendeeList permission. Listing own events does not grant access to unrelated events.

event-write.authority: Create as authenticated person; edit basic fields requires moderator/organizer, proposed-date replacement and deletion require organizer. Consult per-route description and domain writes for exact action.

event-management.authority: Discovery/join uses current friendship, visibility and ban eligibility. Event settings changes require organizer; role/removal use moderator/organizer with organizer and last-organizer protections. Leaving applies to self.

attendance.authority: Self RSVP/availability updates require membership; reading other responses respects viewAttendeeList; choosing/resetting dates requires organizer.

discussion.authority: Reads require event membership; creation follows configured event/post permissions; edits/deletes use author/moderator/organizer rules enforced by discussion domain writes. Related author/attachment projections require separate review before narrower grants.

invitations.authority: Event invitation management follows inviteMembers permission; bearer token inspection/acceptance still requires an API key at the outer handler. Member invitations are recipient/authorized-event-member bound with action-specific current-authority checks.

social.authority: Authenticated person owns friendship requests and blocks; relationship, privacy, request-recipient and block rules remain domain checks.

addons.authority: Event membership for reads; configuration requires event management authority. Participant records/actions are bound to actor and enabled add-on; moderator status does not permit another participant key. Legacy v1 and raw data reads need compatibility/projection review.

addon-authoring.authority: Owned custom template definitions; writes use expectedVersion for optimistic concurrency. Not event participant authority; send_webhook authoring unsupported.

discord.authority: Current identity cached guild authorization/refresh; Discord provider/account integration required. Presence of a cached guild does not certify external provider delivery.

image-upload.authority: Actor owns unclaimed upload and purpose; avatar is self. Cover reads require event membership; cover replacement/removal requires moderator/organizer. Claim and orphan cleanup enforce ownership in domain mutations.

profile-settings.authority: Own profile/preferences/theme ownership, or privacy-filtered username profile read; platform security-sensitive account changes remain browser handoffs.

notifications-muting.authority: Own notifications/mute state; target event/post membership and current access checks vary by operation.

platform-admin.authority: Platform administrator account role, distinct from event organizer/moderator; route performs admin preflight query. Mutations shown here do not receive actor identity, so transaction-level recheck is not established.

cli-exchange.authority: No API key; single-use five-minute browser authorization code with matching PKCE verifier, state and callback port; exchange issues a 90-day account API key. This is current CLI login, not general delegated third-party authorization.

cli-revoke.authority: Presented valid account API key; self-revocation bypasses stored scopes/quota, not expiry/disabled/account-ban checks.

public.authority: No credential required for health, Swagger, OpenAPI or invite metadata. Bearer invitation metadata is intentionally public; do not include bearer tokens or actual responses in search/index evidence.

template-list.authority: Lists published custom templates owned by the authenticated person; no event membership prerequisite. Event configuration/participation follows the separate addons authority profile.

v1-error.shape: {success:false,error:{code,message}} at main/auth handlers; route validation may use default Hono validator shape

commonStatuses.401: UNAUTHORIZED: missing/invalid/expired/disabled key or invalid/banned account
commonStatuses.429: RATE_LIMITED; temporary rate limits include Retry-After seconds
commonStatuses.500: INTERNAL_ERROR; plain/internal errors and transport failures not all domain errors

v1-error.exceptions: Legacy route-level BAD_REQUEST, GDL_PARSE_ERROR and mapped INVITE_UNAVAILABLE; inspect v1 index and route response declarations. Unknown outer-router paths do not necessarily reach Hono.

commonStatuses.400: VALIDATION_ERROR; some route errors BAD_REQUEST or ERROR; CLI exchange validation BAD_REQUEST
commonStatuses.401: UNAUTHORIZED: missing/invalid/expired/disabled key or invalid/banned account
commonStatuses.429: RATE_LIMITED; temporary rate limits include Retry-After seconds
commonStatuses.500: INTERNAL_ERROR; do not infer detailed typed domain failure from raw validators
